# Kihamda Unity monorepo

Read `/AGENTS.md`, `/天啓.md`, `/STATE.md` before acting. Complete repository migration before game production. New games and ports must use Unity under `unity/`. `web/` preserves the existing React portal and URLs; do not create new React games. Keep the fenced business ledger and historical evidence. Do not invoke archived agents or prompts under `legacy/`. No subagents. Do not execute untrusted PR code on self-hosted runners. Do not publish secrets, paid assets or private game sources into this public repository.
